parties.respondent: Reliance General Insurance Co. Ltd. & Anr.

summary: Compensation determination appeal in motor accident case; claimant suffered grievous brain injuries requiring multiple surgeries and prolonged coma; High Court had enhanced compensation from Rs.94,37,300 to Rs.1,24,94,333; Supreme Court found pain/suffering award too low (Rs.2 lakhs), increased to Rs.10 lakhs; similarly increased loss of amenities award from Rs.1 lakh to Rs.10 lakhs, rejecting insurer's argument about duplication with 100% disability compensation; upheld High Court's reduction of interest rate from 9% to 6% per annum.
legal_provisions_cited: Article 136 of the Constitution of India
Raj Kumar vs. Ajay Kumar and Anr., (2011) 1 SCC 343
Lalan D. alias Lal and Anr. vs. Oriental Insurance Company Limited, (2020) 9 SCC 805
final_judgment: Appeal allowed in part; total compensation increased to Rs.1,41,94,333 (Rs.1,24,94,333 plus Rs.10 lakhs for pain/suffering and Rs.10 lakhs for loss of amenities/happiness); interest rate of 6% per annum upheld.
